a.label: Reprogramming of DoD Appropriated Funds (DoD FMR Volume 3, Chapter 6; DD Form 1415 series)

edges.label: Below-threshold and internal reprogramming are where the unsupported adjustments live
edges.note: The FMR permits internal reprogramming on DD 1415-3 with no congressional action and below-threshold realignment with none at all; the FY2025 audit found more than $859 billion of adjustments in two quarters that could not be supported. The inference is that the undocumented volume is concentrated in the layer that generates no external record.
